title: Force rebuild and redeploy all latest changes (Our Legacy page, nav link, brand name, build fixes)

requirements.summary: Create and fully implement the OurLegacy page component with brand heritage intro, Firm Profile CTA, and Visit Nexiris Consultants link, using Layout wrapper and brand styling
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /our-legacy renders the OurLegacy page without errors
'View Firm Profile' button opens the PDF URL in a new tab
'Visit Nexiris Consultants' link opens https://www.nexirisconsultants.com in a new tab
Page uses Montserrat headings and Inter body copy
Page uses Frost White background and Minty Blue accents consistently

file_operations.description: Create the OurLegacy page component with: (1) a brand heritage intro section connecting Nexiris Global to Nexiris Consultants using Frost White background and Minty Blue accents with Montserrat headings and Inter body text; (2) a primary button labeled 'View Firm Profile' that opens https://www.nexirisconsultants.com/_files/ugd/9b0883_a8ad90d67710468a9bdab66b562c8b7a.pdf in a new tab via target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer'; (3) a secondary link/button labeled 'Visit Nexiris Consultants' that opens https://www.nexirisconsultants.com in a new tab. The component must be a default export and use semantic HTML with proper accessibility attributes.

requirements.summary: Register the /our-legacy route in App.tsx within TanStack Router configuration as a child of Layout route, ensuring correct imports and no TypeScript errors
acceptanceCriteria: App.tsx compiles without TypeScript errors
The /our-legacy route resolves to the OurLegacy page component
Existing routes (/, /annual-program) continue to function correctly

file_operations.description: Add the /our-legacy route to the TanStack Router configuration as a child of the Layout route. Import OurLegacy from './pages/OurLegacy' and register it using createRoute with path: '/our-legacy' and component: OurLegacy, ensuring it is added to the routeTree alongside the existing Home and AnnualProgram routes. Verify no TypeScript import or type errors are introduced.

file_operations.description: Add an 'Our Legacy' navigation link in the nav menu (both desktop and mobile versions) alongside 'Home' and 'Pricing'. Use TanStack Router's Link component to navigate to '/our-legacy' with the same active/hover Minty Blue styling applied to other nav links. Ensure the link uses client-side routing and compiles without TypeScript errors.

requirements.summary: Audit and resolve all TypeScript compilation errors across the frontend, fixing broken imports, ensuring HowItWorksSection.tsx is valid or removed, and resolving type mismatches
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend builds with zero TypeScript errors or warnings that block compilation
backend/main.mo compiles without errors
All page routes render correctly in the deployed application
No broken imports remain in any component file

file_operations.description: Ensure HowItWorksSection.tsx is a complete, valid component that renders a 4-step 'How It Works' process with scroll animations. If the component is empty or broken, make it a valid functional component with proper TypeScript types. Verify it exports a default function component and uses correct prop types if any are passed from Home.tsx.

Verify the import of HowItWorksSection is correct and the component is properly integrated in the Home page composition. If HowItWorksSection was empty or broken, ensure it is now imported and rendered correctly. Fix any broken import paths or type errors related to this or other section components.

Audit and fix any broken imports or TypeScript type errors in Navigation.tsx. Ensure all imported modules (e.g., TanStack Router Link, useModal hook) resolve correctly and all component props have proper types.
Audit and fix any broken imports or TypeScript type errors in Footer.tsx. Ensure all imported modules resolve correctly and all component code compiles without errors.
Audit and fix any broken imports or TypeScript type errors in HeroSection.tsx. Ensure all component code compiles without errors and prop types are correctly defined.

Resolve any type mismatches in useQueries.ts, ensuring the useSubmitInquiry mutation hook correctly types the form data parameters and backend actor method call. Verify the mutation function signature matches the expected backend interface.

Resolve any type mismatches in InquiryModal.tsx, ensuring form state types, validation logic, and the useSubmitInquiry hook invocation all have correct TypeScript types. Fix any errors related to modal state or form submission.

requirements.summary: Ensure the Nexiris logo image renders correctly in Navigation.tsx and Footer.tsx using the path '/assets/generated/nexiris-logo.png'

file_operations.description: Update the logo src attribute to '/assets/generated/nexiris-logo.png' and ensure the alt text is set to 'Nexiris Global'. Verify the logo renders on the left side of the navbar with appropriate width and height attributes for optimal display.

Update the logo src attribute to '/assets/generated/nexiris-logo.png' and ensure the alt text is set to 'Nexiris Global'. Set the logo to display at a smaller size appropriate for the footer (e.g., via CSS class or inline height/width), ensuring it renders correctly without a broken image icon.
